Sources and modifications
-------------------------

Russian spelling data by Alexander I. Lebedev, adapted from LibreOffice.
The .aff source is pinned to 12e591abdbc5565e5018ed9b8fbe6d635ade87d7
and the .dic source to 30dd499a102c930b6386d9b0b44ed13e9d4cf8d2
in https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries under ru_RU/.
This modified edition selects entries by weighted coverage of their
inflected forms. It preserves the suffix flags and rules, changes
the declared encoding to KOI8-R and removes comments and blank lines
from the rule file. See LibreOffice-Russian-LICENSE.txt.

The ranking uses Russian frequency data from wordfreq 3.1.1 by Robyn
Speer, https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq. The data are available
under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
The selected word-list data are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 with the
original Lebedev notices and conditions retained. See
wordfreq-NOTICE.md for the source attributions. Frequency tables
are not included. The coverage score describes the ranking input,
not held-out Russian prose.
